summary: Pilot-only tuning grid for kernel logistic regression (RBF + poly2 Nystroem, gamma/C/components) with nested-CV check of the shortlist; prints only
reasoning: Steps 8/17 of the running raw-feature trails show RF and kNN on the twelve given features reach only cv 0.7826/0.7843, so a linear logistic on raw columns (inherited baseline 0.6313) and local methods cannot clear 0.80: the label needs interactions synthesised from those same features. The route's precedent (kernel logistic, provisional cv 0.8678) and the sealed pairs result (0.8923 cv) say kernel-style expansion of the given features gets there. I will grid-search, on pilot.csv only (single thread, prints only, no out/ writes): StandardScaler -> Nystroem(RBF or poly deg-2, gamma, n_components <= 300) -> LogisticRegression(C, max_iter=2000), 5-fold stratified AUC, plus the raw logistic reference, then a nested-CV (5 outer x 3 inner) estimate for the shortlist to size the honest cv_auc for the milestone run.
